queries.query: ramani za ardhi Mombasa Kaunti usajili wa ardhi viwanja huduma rasmi
queries.scope: Search for county-local parcel records, cadastral maps, and public geometry.
queries.result: The Swahili-language search did not surface a Mombasa-specific official parcel-map service. Follow-up first-party county sources identify a county land-administration department and a Land Rates service, but not public parcel vectors.
queries.executionMethod: Separate Swahili-language search followed by first-party county-page inspection; no account or property lookup.

queries.query: Mombasa County cadastral parcel map land rates public GIS official parcel boundaries
queries.scope: Cross-check county property registry activity and anonymous map geometry.
queries.result: Mombasa County ePortal offers Land Rates account actions including paying annual rates, printing statements and property updates/transfers; account creation requires National ID or business registration. The county land department is local. A 2020 county GIS RFP describes planned cadastral digitization and public web maps, not proof of a currently operating public geometry service. No anonymous parcel vectors were found.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language search and first-party county portal/department/procurement inspection; no login.
